meta.title: PeSSiLi — Remote mental health
meta.description: Algerian on-demand platform for licensed psychologists and psychiatrists, in Arabic, French and English.

cookies.title: We use cookies.
cookies.body: They power sign-in, language and your preferences. You can reject optional cookies or accept all, and change your mind later in our privacy notice.

login.asideBody: Tap the ℹ️ icon to reveal demo patient, clinician and admin accounts. This is a local cookie session until Appwrite Auth is wired.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Demo workspace. Replace with Appwrite Auth for production accounts.
dashboard.marksBody: Enter the patient email or serial and a score (1–10). AI summary is generated for the patient notification feed.
dashboard.cloudUploadBody: Files are stored on Cloudinary (authenticated). Patients open them in the browser with their PeSSiLi serial.

doctorDocuments.title: Document title
doctorDocuments.saved: Uploaded — patient can open with their code.

feedbackPage.title: Feedback
feedbackPage.body: Feedback form coming soon. For now, email contact@pessili.dz.

legal.privacyBody: Placeholder notice — finalize Law 18-07 and health consent with your legal counsel.
legal.termsBody: Placeholder terms for the PeSSiLi pilot launch.

footer.brandBlurb: PeSSiLi connects people in every wilaya of Algeria with licensed remote mental health professionals.

home.heroTitle: Licensed mental health care, anywhere in Algeria
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by specialty, language or wilaya
home.welcomeBody: Pessili offers validated screening tools, video / audio / chat sessions, structured reports and secure follow-up—without travelling to a big city.
home.feature1: Arabic/French screening (PHQ-9, GAD-7, …) with automatic scoring.
home.feature2: On-demand or scheduled sessions with verified clinicians.
home.feature3: Encrypted record: notes, prescriptions, PDF reports.
home.feature4: Crisis protocol when risk is flagged.
home.coverageBody: Patients and doctors are mapped to wilayas for local resources and analytics.
home.wilayaPending: Appwrite schema ready — run npm run appwrite:seed-wilayas.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Sign up (email or phone OTP) and pick your wilaya.
howItWorks.step3: Match with a psychologist or psychiatrist.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: Fees are set per verified clinician in DZD. A reduced first session may be offered during the pilot.

crisis.title: Crisis help
crisis.urgentTitle: If you are in immediate danger
crisis.urgentBody: Call official emergency services in your wilaya. PeSSiLi is not an emergency line; local numbers will be shown after legal review.
crisis.disclaimerBody: Screening tools may flag risk; only a licensed professional can assess your situation.

authPages.loginBody: Patient / clinician sign-in (email, phone OTP, roles) will connect to Appwrite Auth in the next MVP iteration.
authPages.registerBody: Choose patient or clinician role, wilaya and preferred language — stored in the profiles collection.

about.title: About PeSSiLi
about.missionBody: Make a first psychological or psychiatric evaluation accessible across Algeria with privacy, cultural respect and continuity of care.

patientNav.label: Patient space
patientNav.welcomeNotifBody: Complete your profile and browse verified clinicians.

patientDashboard.title: Your mental health journey
patientDashboard.subtitle: Remote care, validated screening and follow-up across 69 wilayas.

journey.step2: Run PHQ-9 / GAD-7 screening (Arabic or French).
journey.step3: Book or start a session with a verified clinician.
journey.step4: Receive report, care plan and reminders.

talkNow.title: Talk to someone now
talkNow.desc: Urgent triage for a clinician available on demand.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.desc: Upcoming, past and missed appointments with join checklist.

payments.title: Payments
payments.desc: Consult fee, subscription, wallet and invoices.

consult.title: Consultation
consult.desc: Video, audio or chat — on-demand or scheduled.

cases.title: Cases & documents
cases.desc: Submit your situation and track status and document updates in real time.

serial.title: Patient ID
serial.desc: Give this number to your doctor whenever you speak with them.

messages.title: Messages
messages.desc: Secure channel when a clinician contacts you.

patientCases.pageSubtitle: Live tracking of your requests and record updates.
patientCases.newPageSubtitle: Describe your situation; our team will review it after submission.

patientCases.caseBodyPlaceholder: Symptoms, context, documents you already have…
patientCases.empty: No cases yet. Submit a request to start tracking.

patientProfile.pageSubtitle: Avatar, patient serial number, history and QR quick sign-in.
patientProfile.serialHint: Copy and paste this ID when talking to a doctor (phone, chat or visit).
patientProfile.qrBody: Scan with your phone to sign in without retyping your password (demo).
patientProfile.qrPending: Save your profile to generate a QR code.

patientScreening.title: Screening
patientScreening.body: Validated Arabic/French tools — linking to questionnaires table next.

patientMessages.pageSubtitle: Conversations when clinicians reach out to you.
patientMessages.inboxHint: Doctor messages appear here with live refresh. Reply to confirm a slot or ask a question.

crisisBanner.title: Messages are not for emergencies
crisisBanner.body: If you are in danger or need help right now, use crisis resources or Talk now.

patientRecords.title: Records
patientRecords.subtitle: History and PDF documents from your care.
patientRecords.empty: Complete your profile to store your history.
patientRecords.pdfHint: Enter your PeSSiLi patient code to open each PDF in the browser.
patientRecords.cloudHint: Images and PDFs from clinicians (Cloudinary). Enter your patient code — only you and your care team should know it.
patientRecords.cloudEmpty: No cloud files yet. Ask your clinician to upload after configuring Cloudinary.
patientRecords.accessCodeHint: Same serial as on your profile (PSL-…). Required for privacy.
